display_long_description:
Next-Generation VR Live Platform “NEXST Xmersive”
Now Streaming: UNIS
Coming Soon: KISS OF LIFE

“NEXST Xmersive” is more than live streaming—it delivers a next-level VR concert experience. Real artists come alive through stunning 180-degree high-definition VR, captured in exceptional quality. Feel as if you are sharing the same space, closer than ever before.

As its first featured content, Xmersive presents a live performance by the global girl group “UNIS.” From home, enjoy an experience that surpasses even the very front row of a live venue.

Features

8K Ultra-High Resolution
Visual clarity beyond industry standards.

Immersive VR Live Experience
More than watching—feel face-to-face with the artist, surrounded by breathtaking realism.

180-Degree High-Definition VR Video
High-quality visuals capture every movement and expression.

With premium ultra-high-resolution imaging, it feels as if the artist is singing and dancing right before you. Enjoy intimate performances where even eye contact feels real, delivering unmatched immersion and excitement.

New live content will be added continuously.
Experience a special stage that appears right before your eyes—only on Xmersive.

Contact
For more information, visit: xmersive.nexst.inc
Follow Instagram: @nexst_official
Send feedback to: contact@nexst.inc
 or X @NEXST_AI
